newsitem.title: UK: Thin inquiry reported in European raw cotton.
newsitem.headline: Thin inquiry reported in European raw cotton.

text.p: Interest on European raw cotton markets was confined to occasional inquiry from France and Germany, mostly for avails for September shipment, with the difference between buyers' and trade ideas on price restricting volume.

Markets were also subdued as they awaited the latest USDA 1997/98 crop plantings report. In the event, the assessment of the area under cotton at 14 million acres (including 250,000 devoted to Pima) was well within the range of trade estimates.
